products.title: Clear Day Gel Cleanser
products.body_html:
A gentle daily gel wash for oily-looking, congestion-prone skin.

Key ingredients: salicylic acid 0.5%, zinc PCA, glycerin.

products.title: Soft Milk Cream Cleanser
products.body_html:
A non-stripping cream wash for skin that feels tight.

Key ingredients: colloidal oat, ceramide NP, glycerin.

products.title: Pore Edit Serum
products.body_html:
A lightweight serum for shine and the look of pores.

Key ingredients: niacinamide 5%, zinc PCA.

products.title: Morning Light Serum
products.body_html:
A daytime serum for dull-looking skin.

Key ingredients: ascorbic acid (vitamin C) 10%, ferulic acid, vitamin E.

products.title: Night Shift Serum
products.body_html:
An overnight serum for fine lines and rough texture. Use in the evening.

Key ingredients: retinaldehyde 0.05%, squalane.

products.title: Calm Spot Treatment
products.body_html:
A targeted gel for the occasional blemish.

Key ingredients: benzoyl peroxide 2.5%, allantoin.

products.title: Wide Awake Eye Cream
products.body_html:
A cooling cream for tired-looking eyes.

Key ingredients: caffeine, peptides, hyaluronic acid.

products.title: Barrier Balm Moisturizer
products.body_html:
Rich daily moisture.

Key ingredients: ceramides, squalane, centella asiatica.

products.title: Water Gel Moisturizer
products.body_html:
Weightless hydration that does not feel greasy.

Key ingredients: sodium hyaluronate, niacinamide 2%, glycerin.

products.title: Daily Veil SPF 50
products.body_html:
A sheer daily sunscreen.

Key ingredients: broad-spectrum SPF 50 filters, glycerin.
